name: AppButton
when_to_use: Every primary/secondary action. variant: gradient (primary CTA pill), white (Get Started / Continue / paywall Continue), outlined (design_tokens.button_style), ghost (secondary surface pill).

name: AppProBadge
when_to_use: The GET PRO / Go Premium gradient badge. compact=true for a nav-bar action slot; default for banners. Tap opens a paywall.

name: AppBadge
when_to_use: Small pill tag: discount (tone: accent, e.g. '89% OFF'), PRO/PREMIUM (tone: premium), FREE (tone: success/neutral), status labels.

name: AppCard
when_to_use: Base surface container for any grouped block. selected=true adds a primary outline (paywall package cards, chosen options).

name: AppTextField
when_to_use: Pill search field / generic text entry (sound-picker search, forms).

name: AppChip / AppChipBar
when_to_use: Category filter chips (All, Trends, Gaming, Cinematic, Engine, Memes & Fun). AppChipBar renders a horizontal scrolling row bound to a selected index.

name: AppTopBar
when_to_use: The nav bar for every screen. Supply showBack or showMenu for the leading control and actions (e.g. an AppProBadge). Implements PreferredSizeWidget.

name: AppBottomBar / AppBottomBarItem
when_to_use: Low-level tab bar. Pass a list of AppBottomBarItem and the current index. For the app's four roots use AppMainTabBar instead.

name: AppMainTabBar / AppMainTab
when_to_use: The app's four bottom-tab roots (Drive / Trips / Sounds / Car). Every root screen passes its own AppMainTab; the bar owns the labels, icons and cross-tab navigation.

name: AppScaffold
when_to_use: Page shell for every screen: token background, optional AppTopBar/bottom bar, and a full-bleed background layer for splash/paywall hero media. onboarding=true paints the darker onboarding background.

name: AppListTile
when_to_use: Generic settings / menu / drawer row with a tinted leading icon, optional trailing value or widget, and a chevron.

name: AppSlotCard
when_to_use: The three cue slots on the Drive Sounds home (Departure / Arrival / Home). Shows the assigned sound name or an empty label.

name: AppSoundRow
when_to_use: A row in the sound library / picker: play/pause preview, title + category, PRO tag, and a radio (or lock when premium & not entitled).

name: AppSectionHeader
when_to_use: Titled section header above grouped lists / settings groups, with an optional trailing action ('See all').

name: AppBanner
when_to_use: Inline notice banner. tone: warning (warning_bg/warning_text cream tip, e.g. 'not activated yet') or info (translucent primary).

name: AppEmptyState
when_to_use: Centered zero-result / no-selection / error placeholder with a soft glyph, headline, message and optional CTA.
